props.gloss_en: Rava: even if you say [the mishna forbids] sipping and swallowing -- here (the baraita, permitting) is before dipping, here (the mishna, forbidding) is after dipping
Rava: there is nothing permitted on Shabbat and forbidden on Yom Kippur -- since it is permitted on Shabbat, it is permitted on Yom Kippur too
the baraita: all who are obligated in immersions immerse in their usual way, both on the Ninth of Av and on Yom Kippur

objections.gloss_en: ונימא: מדלפני טיבול שרי -- לאחר טיבול נמי שרי, דשמעינן ליה לרבא דאית ליה הואיל -- let us say: since before dipping it is permitted, after dipping it is permitted too, for we have heard that Rava holds 'since'
